ABB in India at a glance
ABB Group
ABB is a global technology leader in 
electrification and automation, 
enabling a more sustainable and 
resource-efficient future. By 
connecting its engineering and 
digitalization expertise, ABB helps 
industries run at high performance, 
while becoming more efficient, 
productive and sustainable so they 
outperform. At ABB, we call this 
‘Engineered to Outrun’. The company 
has over 140 years of history and 
around 110,000 employees worldwide. 
ABB’s shares are listed on the SIX 
Swiss Exchange (ABBN) and Nasdaq 
Stockholm (ABB).
ABB in India
ABB is present in India for over a 
century and manufacturing for more 
than 75 years. The manufacturing unit 
is a listed entity. It operates with the 
entire eco-system of ABB R&D, 
Engineering, and Services.
